no_access.title: Admin console not available
no_access.description: Your account is not a platform admin. Ask a super admin to grant you a role, or set PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS on the server.
no_access.sign_in_different: Sign in as a different user

overview.title: Overview
overview.tasks_none: No tasks in the last 24 hours.

users.title: Users
users.disable_dialog_description: Every session and token of {{email}} stops working within a minute. Their data stays intact and the account can be re-enabled.
users.enable_dialog_description: {{email}} can sign in again right away.
users.workspaces_empty: Not a member of any workspace.
users.revoke_dialog_description: Any CLI or daemon using {{prefix}}… stops authenticating immediately. This cannot be undone.

admins.title: Platform admins
admins.add_dialog_description: The user must already have a Multica account. Granting an existing admin changes their role.
admins.remove_dialog_description: {{email}} loses access to the admin console immediately. Their regular account is unaffected.

registry.title: Template marketplace
registry.upload_dialog_description: A zip in the Claude Code plugin layout: .claude-plugin/plugin.json plus skills/ and .mcp.json. A new name creates a draft listing; an existing name adds a version awaiting review.
registry.upload_no_source: Add an uploadable source (self or official) first.
registry.upload_file_hint: Up to 4 MB. hooks/ and commands/ are refused.
registry.changelog_placeholder: What changed in this version. Falls back to CHANGELOG.md in the package.
registry.status_dialog_description: Only published listings with an approved version are offered to consumers.
registry.publish_needs_approved: Publishing needs at least one approved version.
registry.public_hint: Anyone can read it without an API key, including anonymous Claude Code users.

targeting.title: Visibility
targeting.empty: Not targeted at any consumer. Only public listings are visible without targeting.
targeting.dialog_description: Each row grants one consumer, for all of its tenants, one tenant or one tenant group. Saving replaces the whole list.

review.approve_description: Approving {{version}} offers it to every consumer the listing targets. Upgrades are opt-in on the consumer side.
review.reject_description: Rejecting {{version}} keeps it in the registry but never offers it. It can be approved later.
review.revoke_description: Revoking {{version}} withdraws it from every consumer now. Existing installations keep running until they upgrade or uninstall.

sources.title: Sources
sources.empty: No sources yet. Add one to upload templates into its namespace.
sources.kind_hint: Uploads go to self-built and official sources; third-party and skills sources are synced in a later phase.
sources.add_dialog_description: A source is a namespace of templates, such as @self. The namespace cannot change afterwards.
sources.disable_dialog_description: Every listing under {{namespace}} disappears from every consumer immediately. Installed copies keep running.
sources.enable_dialog_description: Published listings under {{namespace}} are offered again.

consumers.title: Consumers
consumers.intro: Products that read the marketplace. Each gets an API key for the public read API; Multica itself reads in-process.
consumers.add_dialog_description: The API key is shown once after creation; store it in the consumer's configuration.
consumers.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used in targeting and install reports; cannot change.
consumers.rotate_dialog_description: The current key of {{name}} stops working immediately. The new key is shown once.
consumers.disable_dialog_description: {{name}} can no longer read the marketplace or report installs.
consumers.enable_dialog_description: {{name}} can read the marketplace again with its existing key.
consumers.issued_description: Copy the key for {{name}} now. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.

reason.label: Reason
reason.placeholder: Why are you doing this? Recorded in the audit log.
